claims.statement: ecshopx-bootstrap/src/main/resources/application.properties is the single central configuration file for the whole application: because a library Bundle jar's own internal application.properties is not merged into the outer application's Environment, the bootstrap file re-declares keys the Bundles' @Value lookups need (e.g. the full espier.shopex-usercenter.* block, commented "must be defined for bootstrap Environment (library jar application.properties is not auto-merged)").

Two deployment shapes consume the central file differently: the Docker compose stacks (docker-compose.dev.yml and docker-lite/docker-compose.yml) never activate the local profile and inject overrides as Spring Boot CLI-style APP_ARGS plus environment variables, while self-hosted/IDE runs have no shipped overlay — application-local.properties is git-ignored and exists only where a developer created it — so their overrides arrive via environment variables, --key=value program arguments, or --spring.config.additional-location=file:./config/.

Keys are read through three mechanisms with different failure modes: @Value("${key:default}") for scalar keys (requires the key to exist when no default is given), @ConfigurationProperties(prefix=...) for grouped keys (35 classes across the Bundles, e.g. StorageProperties on ecshopx.storage, H5JwtProperties on ecshopx.h5.jwt, PrismCoreProperties on ecshopx.thirdparty.prism-core, DoumenIntlProperties on ecshopx.payment.doumen-intl), and Environment.getProperty where the key name itself is dynamic (SuperadminWxappTemplateMetadataService builds ecshopx.wechat.wxa-template-fallback.<key>.* names at runtime from the DB key). SocialTrustLoginService uses only @Value properties for its hosts — it contains no System.getenv calls: common.h5-base-url is the single allow-listed H5 host (resolveH5Host/resolveAppleCallbackH5Host accept a requested host only when it equals this property and return empty when it is blank; buildAppleH5LandingUrl throws 缺少 H5 域名配置), common.api-base-url with an APP_URL fallback builds the Apple OAuth API callback URI, and the opaque Apple OAuth state is bound to the host only via a one-time Redis entry (ecx:apple_oauth:h5:<md5(state)>, 600s TTL, written only when the host matches common.h5-base-url).

spring.config.import in application.properties pulls in four optional classpath ymls (request-field, bspay, shuyun, members) that provide module-local grouped config: ecshopx.request-field (registration-form default fields and must-start-required lists consumed by RequestFieldDefaultConfigProvider), ecshopx.bspay.callback.rsa-public-key (BSPay callback signature verification), ecshopx.shuyun.open-platform (Shuyun open-platform bases/secrets), and ecshopx.trustlogin.default (social sign-in provider defaults).

A second family of module-local files is NOT on the spring.config.import list — Bundles that ship their own <module>/src/main/resources/application.properties (companys: license.gateway.* and ecshopx.companys.item-start-num.weak-string-equals-mode; kujiale: ecshopx.kujiale.cities-json.insecure-tls; espier: espier.upgrade.storage-root) or a module-local application-local.properties (hfpay: ecshopx.hfpay.storage-root, bg-ret-url, ecshopx.filesystem.import-image-public-base) — so those jar-internal copies act only as documentation of each module's keys unless re-declared in the central file or via APP_ARGS.

JWT configuration is layered through env overlays: JWT_SECRET (empty in the repo template, Base64 of a 32-byte key) feeds both ecshopx.h5.jwt.secret-base64 (H5 member JWT) and ecshopx.merchant.wxapp.jwt.secret-base64 (merchant wxapp onboarding JWT, issuer ecshopx, 60-minute TTL), with JWT_TTL default 120 minutes, JWT_REFRESH_TTL default 20160 minutes measured from iat, and JWT_BLACKLIST_GRACE_PERIOD default 0 seconds; both properties classes zero-pad a decoded key shorter than 32 bytes for Nimbus MACSigner.

common.product-model (default platform) is both a runtime switch and an install-time database seed: it is read by @Value in at least six services (operator auth, shop menus, Shuyun operator facade, goods distributor resolution, espier member-token enrichment, operator-cart reader), and the install scripts map install mode b2c→standard / bbc→platform into PRODUCT_MODEL, persist it to the compose .env so APP_ARGS carries --common.product-model=..., and sync companys.menu_type to 4 (b2c) or 3 (bbc).

File storage is selected by ecshopx.storage.driver (local / oss / qiniu / aws / cosv5, default local with local.root=storage/app/public and local.url=http://localhost:18080/storage); StorageFactory.disk(fileType) switches on the driver and throws 请选择正确的存储系统！ for an unknown value, and the per-disk file/image/videos split exists only for the oss, qiniu and cosv5 drivers. ecshopx.storage.import-file.* is a separate S3-style client for import/CSV export with repo defaults region=us-east-1 and path-style-access=true, deliberately blank for ops injection.

WeChat Open Platform third-party authorization requires all three of ecshopx.wechat.open.component-appid, component-appsecret and component-verify-ticket to be non-blank; WechatOpenPlatformAuthorizerTokenService.assertOpenPlatformComponentReady throws 微信开放平台组件配置不完整 / component_verify_ticket 未配置或未同步 when any is missing, while is_direct=1 authorizations bypass the component check entirely.

WeChat mini-program template resolution is DB-first with a properties fallback: SuperadminWxappTemplateMetadataService queries the wxapp_template table by key_name and only on a miss reads ecshopx.wechat.wxa-template-fallback.<key>.* from the Environment; ecshopx.wechat.wxa-template-list-fallback-keys (default yykweishop) is the comma-separated key list WxaGetTemplateListService iterates to build the template list from properties when no enabled DB row exists.

Payment channel credentials are NOT in the central properties file — they live per tenant in Redis (wxPaymentSetting:<sha1(companyId)> and sibling keys) — while the file carries only platform-level notify URLs (ecshopx.payment.wechat.notify-url consumed by DepositWxpayRechargeUnifyService for the WeChat v2 unified-order notify_url, and ecshopx.payment.alipay.notify-url) plus channel toggles like ecshopx.payment.hfpay-is-open (HfpayVersionStatusService parses 1/true/yes/on as true) and the Doumen-intl group.

Empty third-party gateway base URLs change behaviour rather than failing: PrismCoreHttpClient/PrismIshopexHttpClient/ShuyunSignedGatewayClient all guard on isConfigured() (hasText on base-url + app-key + app-secret) and return null before any HTTP, so callers silently degrade; ShopexErpOpenApiClient.call returns {"fail_msg":"ome openapi url not configured"} when ecshopx.ome.openapi-url is blank.

Empty APP_URL or ecshopx.jushuitan.oauth-base-url changes the Jushuitan admin setting payload: with APP_URL blank the shop_callback_url is emitted as the relative path /api/systemlink/jushuitan/{companyId}, and with oauth-base-url blank oauth_url is a bare ?query-string; a non-empty oauth-base-url must start with https:// or JushuitanSettingAdminService.getSetting throws BadRequestException (聚水潭 OAuth 地址必须为 https 绝对 URL).

The http-enabled / NoOp gating pattern (DmCrm point-detail-list and update-member-info-by-mobile, Shuyun member-modify and member-unbind, Shopex CRM sync-single-member, Marketing Center, Shansong, WorkWechat, and WeChat wxa subscribe-template) selects the *NoOp bean when the flag is false or missing via @ConditionalOnProperty(matchIfMissing=true) and the HTTP implementation when true; additionally ecshopx.thirdparty.dm-crm.setting-read.redis-enabled=false unregisters DmCrmSettingReadRedisService so DmCrmSettingReadNoOp treats every company as unintegrated with Hope.

Some empty keys are safe-by-design rather than hazards: ecshopx.common.api-token blank means GET /api/v1/operator/credential always rejects with 无权访问该API,签名错误 (closed, not open); common.encrypt-sensitive-data=true is a hard startup failure because OperatorsQueryService.assertEncryptMode throws IllegalStateException; openapi.debug=1 is a debug-only bypass that, after the required-parameter checks, stamps auth with the openapi.system-company-id @Value (falling back to common.system-companys-id, default 1) and returns, skipping timestamp tolerance, sign verification, the developer lookup and the replay guard entirely.

ADMIN_LOGIN_CHECK_LEVEL=img_code activates a captcha requirement on admin login (RequiresImgCodeWhenLevelValidator requires a non-blank token and yzm pair); any other value including empty skips the check.

SMS scene whitelists are a consistency contract, not a silent filter: AliyunsmsSmsSceneWhitelistProperties.resolveSceneNames(productModel) maps a product-model slug (b2c/platform/standard/in_purchase) to its key list, and AliyunsmsSceneSimpleListService filters the company's scene rows against it and throws 场景数据不完整 when some DB scenes fall outside the whitelist; the product-model key comes from ShopMenuService.resolveProductModelKeyForCompany (companys.menu_type), not from a property.

Redis logical-DB selectors are per-environment knobs whose tracked defaults in application.properties are companys=0, prism=2, datacube=0, deposit=1 (spring.data.redis.database=0; the wechat selector is commented out and falls back to spring.data.redis.database): the deposit selector is the documented trap where the operator dashboard real_deposit reads a different logical DB than the recharge writers unless the deployment aligns them — CompanysDepositDayRechargeRedisReader reads dayRechargeTotal hashes through depositStringRedisTemplate (ecshopx.redis.deposit.database, default 1) while AdapayDepositTradeRechargeCallbackService increments the same hashes through sharedStringRedisTemplate (spring.data.redis.database) — and the properties comment on the deposit key is the only in-repo hint of that coupling; since there is no tracked local overlay, per-environment selector values arrive via APP_ARGS or environment variables.

docker/install-secrets.sh is a sourced helper library (not standalone) providing the production secret-injection flow for dev-setup.sh and docker-lite/deploy.sh: install_ensure_jwt_secret resolves JWT_SECRET from the env var, then the compose .env, then application.properties (read-only), generating via openssl rand -base64 32 when absent and persisting only to the compose .env (never mutating tracked application.properties or application-local.properties); install_prompt_admin_password takes ADMIN_PASSWORD or an interactive /dev/tty prompt with a 6-char minimum; install_hash_bcrypt hashes via Node inside the running app container (ecshopx-app / ecshopx-dev-app) or, failing that, a local runtime image (RUNTIME_BASE_IMAGE / APP_IMAGE / ecshopx-app:latest / ecshopx-java:17-node22-openresty), using docker/tools/bcrypt-hash.js + bcrypt.min.js; install_apply_admin_password waits for MySQL then UPDATEs operators.password for the admin row; install_persist_product_model/install_apply_company_menu_type map b2c/bbc to standard/platform and menu_type 4/3.

The Docker compose stacks thread JWT_SECRET twice into the app container — once as a container environment variable and once inside APP_ARGS as --JWT_SECRET=${JWT_SECRET} — alongside the datasource/Redis/Flyway/xxl-job overrides and --common.product-model=${PRODUCT_MODEL:-platform}; the compose .env files that persist these values are git-ignored: .env at the repo root (.gitignore L11) and docker-lite/.env (.gitignore L13).

Repo defaults are dev-only by design: JWT_SECRET is empty in application.properties, spring.datasource.password=ecshopx and spring.data.redis.password=redispassword match the compose demo containers (MySQL root password rootpassword, redis --requirepass redispassword), and every third-party/storage credential ships blank; the readme states that in production real secrets must be injected via environment variables or an external configuration centre and repo defaults never reused.

common.use-system-menu gates the bootstrap startup seed runner rather than a request path: MigrationSeedRunner (an ApplicationRunner that runs once after Spring context readiness and Flyway migration) deletes all company_id=0 menus and re-imports seed/menu/*.json when true and skips that re-import when false, while the logistics seed (seed/logistics/kuaidi.json) runs regardless but only when the logistics table is empty.

ecshopx.mail.password.app-key / .cipher implement the PHP Laravel APP_KEY + AES-256-CBC mail-password codec (fixed IV, HMAC-SHA256 over base64(iv)+base64(ciphertext), no PHP serialization); when the key is missing MailSettingPasswordCodec degrades to passing plaintext through instead of failing.

ecshopx.popularize.common-defaults.* image URLs are coalescing defaults applied at save time by PopularizeSettingSaveService.applyCommonImageDefaults: missing/null values (and, for banner/applets, also empty strings) fall back to the configured property, so the repo's yuanyuanke CDN URLs are placeholders that must match production.

ecshopx.common.demo-company-ids is a comma-separated company_id list consumed by AdapayOpenAccountStepService to force sensitive-data masking on the AdaPay open-account step (PHP legacy demo_company_id parity); empty means no demo-tenant masking.

Undertow is the embedded server and server.tomcat.* is ignored; besides the property-driven allow-unescaped-characters-in-url and 64MB max-http-post-size, UndertowMultipartMaxEntityCustomizer hard-codes Undertow's separate multipart entity cap to 64MB and enables ALLOW_ENCODED_SLASH in code, because Undertow 2.3+ enforces its own ~2MB multipart cap independent of spring.servlet.multipart.* (50MB/55MB).

ecshopx-bootstrap/src/main/resources/application-local.properties is git-ignored via .gitignore line 7 and therefore absent from fresh checkouts — the readme's claim that the project 'already includes' it as a local development sample is drift; any local-profile file in use is user-created, and in contrast the hfpay module's ecshopx-hfpay/src/main/resources/application-local.properties IS tracked in the repository.

The social trust-login Apple OAuth flow treats common.h5-base-url as the single trusted H5 host: query-supplied h5_host values and unsigned state payloads are ignored unless they exactly match the configured property, the opaque state is a 32-byte random value whose host binding lives only in Redis (ecx:apple_oauth:h5:<md5(state)>, 600s TTL, one-time via getAndDelete), and resolveAppleCallbackH5Host returns empty when common.h5-base-url is blank — so a missing H5 base URL fails the flow closed rather than falling back to request input.

JWT_SECRET doubles as the POS token signing key: PosJwtIssuer (issuing, HS512, TTL = JWT_TTL minutes) and PosJwtAuthenticationFilter (verifying) both build their HMAC SecretKey from the Base64-decoded bytes of JWT_SECRET, falling back to raw UTF-8 bytes only when the value is not valid Base64, and both throw IllegalStateException("JWT_SECRET is required") at construction when it is blank — so a missing JWT_SECRET is a hard startup failure for the POS auth path, not just the H5 one.

POS_JWT_ISSUER (code default ecshopx-pos, not listed in application.properties) is the iss claim PosJwtIssuer writes into POS tokens and one of the two markers PosJwtAuthenticationFilter accepts: a Bearer token is treated as a POS token when its token_kind claim equals pos or its iss claim equals the configured issuer.

DigiOS integration keys bind to DigiOsProperties (@ConfigurationProperties prefix ecshopx.digios) and ship nowhere in application.properties: the class supplies the only tracked defaults — enabled=false, base-url=https://hobbits.ishopex.cn, empty client-id/app-secret, 10s/5s timeouts, token-path /gateway/token with 120s expire skew, co-code Shopex001, biz-model 0, ter-cd ECX, default-op-hours 10:00,22:00, regions-json classpath:digios_regions.json, stock-push-max-rows 200, adjustment doc types code_000008/code_000009, and a method→path map for warehouse/logic/store/account/adjustment endpoints — so operators override via APP_ARGS/env or overlays.

DigiOS per-company overrides live in the digios_company_config database table, not in properties: DigiOsCompanyConfigAdminService backs GET/POST /api/v1/digios/company_config with one row per tenant (is_enabled, base_url, client_id→app_key, app_secret), validating that enabling requires a base URL, Client ID and App Secret, enforcing a globally unique Client ID across tenants, and preserving the stored secret when app_secret is omitted; DigiOsConfigService.resolve(companyId) layers a row with is_enabled=1 and non-blank base_url/app_key/app_secret over the platform-level DigiOsProperties values while timeouts, token path, co-code and the method map always come from the properties.

ShuyunOpenPlatformProperties (@ConfigurationProperties prefix ecshopx.shuyun.open-platform) configures the Shuyun open-api/open-client integration isolated from the legacy UAPI gateway (ecshopx.thirdparty.shuyun.*): the tracked application-shuyun.yml carries only base-uri, timeout-seconds, token-refresh-base-uri, the empty DELTA-001 fallback-gateway-access-token, the env-overlaid callback-identity-secret/auth-value, callback-debug-log, offline-plat-id-suffix and merge-dispatch-ttl-seconds, while every other key (callback-sign-include-body=true, callback-replay-skew-seconds=300, callback-replay-ttl-seconds=600, token-callback save retry settings, gateway-partner=nnormal, offline-benefit-* including issuer=kaquan, and the order-class→trade-source map normal=11 … drug=21) comes from class defaults.

The XXL-JOB executor block in application.properties pins executor appname ecshopx-executor and port 19999 (plus admin addresses http://127.0.0.1:9080/xxl-job-admin, accessToken ecshopx-cron-dev, logpath logs/xxl-job and logretentiondays 7), with the compose stacks overriding the admin addresses via APP_ARGS.

A fifth module-local profile, ecshopx-shopmenu-border/src/main/resources/application-shopmenu-border.yml (langue.* plus shopmenu.is-show-audit-log-path=logs/shopmenu_is_show_hidden.log), is NOT on the spring.config.import list — its header marks it as optionally importable but nothing imports it, so the shopmenu value applies only if an operator adds it to the import list; otherwise ShopmenuAuditLogProperties' class default (the same path) governs.

Two enabled-by-default notification toggles ship in application.properties: ecshopx.orders.delivery-success-notify.enabled=true registers OrderDeliverySuccessNotifyWechatService (sends the orderDeliverySucc mini-program subscribe message on shipment) while false swaps in OrderDeliverySuccessNotifyNoOp, and ecshopx.wechat.wxa-card-template-send.enabled=true registers WxaCardUsedTemplateSendPortImpl (coupon receive / registration result scenes; cardUsedSucc is always skipped) while false selects WxaCardUsedTemplateSendNoOp.

langue.* binds to LangueProperties (@ConfigurationProperties prefix langue), which validates at startup via @PostConstruct that default-lang is non-blank and is a member of langue.list, throwing IllegalStateException otherwise — so a misconfigured language pair is a hard startup failure rather than a silent fallback to zh-CN.

Shuyun open-platform admin configuration is persisted per tenant in the database (`company_shuyun_open_platform_config`, always stamped plat_code=OFFLINE), not in properties: OpenPlatformConfigService masks the stored app_secret and access_token for the admin view, classifies admin saves into credential-bootstrap / access-token-only / enable-only patches, fills a blank auth_value from the auth-value property on save, and rejects enabling sync without a stored non-expired access_token.

The mobile-POS member readiness flow (OperatorStoreMemberReadinessService) introduces no new configuration keys; it consults the same per-tenant DB row and silently skips member registration unless the row is enabled with eligible credentials, so the ecshopx.shuyun.open-platform.* properties act only as cold-start defaults.

OpenAPI public-path auth uses a hardcoded 600-second timestamp tolerance and replays that same value as the TTL to OpenapiSignedRequestReplayGuard (ECX-10869), which deduplicates app_key|sign|timestamp via Redis SETNX on openapi:auth:replay:{sha256}; neither the tolerance nor the TTL is property-configurable, and openapi.debug=1 bypasses the guard entirely.

BrokeragePlanCloseTimeService computes the distribution commission settlement timestamp as plan_close_time = now (epoch seconds) + 86400 * (settleDays + aftersaleDays), where settleDays and aftersaleDays come from @Value("${ecshopx.popularize.brokerage-plan-close.settle-days:0}") and @Value("${ecshopx.popularize.brokerage-plan-close.aftersale-days:0}"); the code carries an explicit TODO that these placeholders should be replaced by the merchant-side 分销确认天数/售后时效天数 settings, so today they are flat platform-wide day offsets not wired to any merchant setting.

The plan_close_time value produced by BrokeragePlanCloseTimeService is written onto unsettled brokerage rows in two places: on order confirm-receipt finish, NormalOrderBrokerageOnFinishService calls updatePlanCloseTime which UPDATEs brokerage rows matching companyId/orderId with is_close=false; and at commission-row insert, NormalOrderFinishBrokerageCoordinator stamps each new row's plan_close_time via computePlanCloseTimeEpochSec().

Shop protocol values are stored as JSON fields of the companys Redis hash hash:companyProtocol[:{lang}]:{sha1(companyId)} via the primary companysRedisTemplate, and because every save also appends a protocol_update_log row, ShopProtocolSetService.get() repopulates the hash from the DB on a miss (ECX-11114): an empty hash triggers repopulateAllTypesFromDbIfPresent (latest log row per type) and a blank single field triggers repopulateSingleTypeFromDbIfPresent, each rebuilding the JSON and writing it back to Redis — so flushing that Redis DB no longer loses protocol content. Draft (*_draft) and member_logout_config fields are never repopulated, and nothing is written when the DB has no row.

The members-side H5 reader H5RegisterProtocolQueryService reads the same companyProtocol hash directly through the default StringRedisTemplate with no DB fallback, so immediately after a flush of the companys Redis DB the H5 register/privacy protocol endpoints answer empty until an admin-side ShopProtocolSetService.get() repopulates the key.
